title: Adana Kebab
description: A legendary charcoal-grilled kebab from southern Turkey made with finely minced lamb, traditional pepper, paprika, and tail fat for an intensely juicy and smoky finish.

ingredients.title: Kebab Mixture
items: 100 g lamb tail fat, finely minced

instruction.title: Prepare the Mixture
steps: Combine the minced lamb and finely minced tail fat.
Add pepper paste, paprika, Aleppo pepper, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Knead firmly for 5 to 7 minutes until the mixture becomes sticky and cohesive.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.

instruction.title: Shape the Kebabs
steps: Wet your hands lightly with cold water.
Divide the mixture into four portions.
Press each portion firmly around a wide flat metal skewer.
Shape into long, even kebabs with shallow ridges along the surface.

instruction.title: Grill Over Charcoal
steps: Prepare a very hot charcoal grill.
Place the kebabs over high heat.
Grill for approximately 3 to 4 minutes per side.
Turn frequently enough to cook evenly while developing deep char.
Grill the green peppers and tomatoes alongside the kebabs.

instruction.title: Prepare the Onion Garnish
steps: Combine sliced red onion with sumac and chopped parsley.
Massage gently until the onion softens slightly.
Set aside until serving.

instruction.title: Serve
steps: Warm the lavash briefly over the grill.
Place the kebabs over the lavash.
Add grilled peppers and tomatoes.
Finish with the sumac onion salad and lemon wedges.
Serve immediately.

servingSuggestions.title: Traditional Grill Presentation
items: Add sumac onions beside the kebab.
Finish with fresh parsley and lemon.
Pair with ayran or a fresh Turkish salad.

chefTips: Use lamb with enough natural fat for a juicy kebab.
Traditional tail fat provides exceptional flavor and texture.
Kneading is essential because it creates the characteristic cohesive texture.
Keep the grill extremely hot to achieve proper charcoal char.
Do not press the kebab repeatedly while grilling or valuable juices will be lost.
Shape the kebabs evenly so they cook at the same rate.
Serve immediately while the kebab is smoky and juicy.
